checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even 'around $X' or 'about half price' counts.

bot claims a bookable trial program that is NOT one of: Adult Intro to Mixed Martial Arts, Adult Kickboxing, Adult Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Adult No-Gi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Adult Boxing, Youth 4-6 Martial Arts, Youth 7-12 Martial Arts. The following are REAL Ray Longo's MMA programs in the verified KB (non-bookable / Members Only / covered, no separate trial calendar) and must NOT be flagged as hallucinations: MMA, Mixed Martial Arts, Sparring, Kickboxing Drills, Introductory Boxing, Gi Jiu-Jitsu, Youth Martial Arts, Youth MMA, Members Only. Only flag source-bleed program names from OTHER gyms (e.g. Vacaville, Bodega, Gracie, Logica, Sugoi, Fun Jitsu).
bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.
bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' where it should give a firm known answer (e.g. Members Only not bookable, under-4 not bookable).

bot proactively names/pushes a specific adult discipline (Kickboxing, BJJ, No-Gi, Boxing) before the lead states a preference. It may ask which discipline; it must not steer. Default intro is Mixed Martial Arts.
bot output contains unreplaced tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, UNRESOLVED(contact.phone), {{nodes.X.result}}.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks who it is for (self / child / both) before collecting names, DOBs, contact details.
bot asks date of birth (not just age) for each enrollee before the booking tool fires.

when the adult names a discipline the booking is for that calendar: kickboxing->Adult Kickboxing; BJJ/jiu-jitsu/gi->Adult Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu; no-gi->Adult No-Gi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu; boxing->Adult Boxing. No discipline stated or MMA->Adult Intro to Mixed Martial Arts (default). Wrong-calendar booking is a fail.
ages 4-6 -> Youth 4-6 Martial Arts; ages 7-12 -> Youth 7-12 Martial Arts. Cross-band routing is a mis-route. Under age 4 -> NO booking, refer to gym (516) 900-9042.

checkpoints.description: 13-17 no-cal handled as referral, no booking
checkpoints.look_for: if enrollee is 13-17, bot does NOT book any calendar. Must capture guardian info and state team will follow up. No appointment in GHL.
if lead pushes pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to the free intro / staff. Never gives a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: lead under 18 with no parent/guardian involved: bot must NOT book. Capture name + DOB + parent contact, close with team-will-follow-up framing.

checkpoints.description: Members Only / non-bookable acknowledged, not booked
checkpoints.look_for: Members Only advanced MMA, advanced Kickboxing, and Sparring: bot acknowledges they exist but does NOT book them and does not invent a calendar; defers to the free intro class in an open discipline. No substitute-calendar routing.
